Four schedules, one canvas. Drag peak LR.zh: 四种调度，同一画布。拖动峰值学习率、预热比例与总步数 — 精确观察学习率在训练过程中的变化，并理解为何 Transformer 以满学习率冷启动时会在最初 100 步内发散。
Four schedules, one canvas. Drag peak LR.src: Four schedules, one canvas. Drag peak LR, warmup fraction, total steps — see exactly how the learning rate moves through training, and why Transformers cold-started at full LR diverge in their first 100 steps.

The @@T0@@same@@T1@@ optimizer can succe.zh: @@T0@@同一个@@T1@@优化器能否成功，取决于你为它套上怎样的学习率调度。以 @@T2@@lr = 3e-4@@T3@@ 对 Transformer 冷启动 Adam，会在数百步内发散。而若从 0 开始线性预热，同一架构便能平稳训练。
The @@T0@@same@@T1@@ optimizer can succe.src: The same optimizer can succeed or fail depending on the learning rate schedule you wrap around it. Cold-starting Adam on a Transformer with lr = 3e-4 diverges within a few hundred steps. Warm it up linearly from 0 and the same architecture trains cleanly.

PyTorch for the current schedule.zh: 当前调度对应的 PyTorch 代码

Why Transformers need warmup.zh: 为何 Transformer 需要预热

Adam's second-moment estimate @@T0@@v̂_t.zh: Adam 的二阶矩估计 @@T0@@v̂_t@@T1@@ 在第 1 步时既小又含噪。用 @@T2@@√v̂_t@@T3@@ 作除数会极大地放最初若干步。与此同时，随机初始化的注意力会产生尖峰状的分布 — 少数注意力头中出现较大的早期梯度。二者叠加，以满学习率冷启动便会产生巨大而不稳定的初始步，损失随之发散。
Adam's second-moment estimate @@T0@@v̂_t.src: Adam's second-moment estimate v̂_t is tiny and noisy at step 1. Dividing by √v̂_t wildly amplifies the first few steps. Meanwhile, random-init attention produces peaky distributions — large early gradients in a few heads. Combined, cold-starting at full LR produces huge unstable first steps, and the loss diverges.

Warmup linearly ramps LR from 0 to peak.zh: 预热在训练的前 1–10% 内将学习率从 0 线性升至峰值。一旦 @@T0@@v̂_t@@T1@@ 经过若干步趋于稳定、注意力也已变得分散，便可安全地维持峰值学习率。
Warmup linearly ramps LR from 0 to peak.src: Warmup linearly ramps LR from 0 to peak over 1–10% of training. Once v̂_t has a few steps to stabilize and attention has diffused, you can safely ride the peak LR.

The four-stage anatomy of a modern LR sc.zh: 现代学习率调度的四阶段解剖
The four-stage anatomy of a modern LR sc.src: The four-stage anatomy of a modern LR schedule

@@T0@@Warmup (0 → peak).@@T1@@ Linear ra.zh: @@T0@@预热（0 → 峰值）。@@T1@@ 在总步数的 1–10% 内线性上升。稳定 Adam 的矩估计，并让初始化有时间趋于平稳。
@@T0@@Warmup (0 → peak).@@T1@@ Linear ra.src: Warmup (0 → peak). Linear ramp for 1–10% of total steps. Stabilises Adam's moment estimates and gives initialisation time to settle.

@@T0@@Peak (constant or near-constant).@.zh: @@T0@@峰值（恒定或近乎恒定）。@@T1@@ 训练的主体部分。一些方案（Llama、Chinchilla）保持恒定；另一些（余弦、Noam）则在预热结束后立即开始衰减。
@@T0@@Peak (constant or near-constant).@.src: Peak (constant or near-constant). The bulk of training. Some recipes (Llama, Chinchilla) hold constant; others (cosine, Noam) start decaying immediately after warmup.

@@T0@@Decay (peak → near-zero).@@T1@@ Co.zh: @@T0@@衰减（峰值 → 近零）。@@T1@@ 余弦、线性或阶梯。具体形状不如幅度重要 — 关键在于最终学习率要足够低。
@@T0@@Decay (peak → near-zero).@@T1@@ Co.src: Decay (peak → near-zero). Cosine, linear, or step. The exact shape matters less than the magnitude — what matters is reaching a sufficiently low final LR.

@@T0@@Tail (~0).@@T1@@ Optional. Final l.zh: @@T0@@尾部（约 0）。@@T1@@ 可选。最后阶段以低学习率进行收尾微调。在 LLM 预训练中属标准做法。
@@T0@@Tail (~0).@@T1@@ Optional. Final l.src: Tail (~0). Optional. Final low-LR steps for last-mile fine-tuning. Standard in LLM pretraining.

Schedule cheatsheet by use case.zh: 按使用场景分类的调度速查表

@@T0@@Computer vision (ResNet, ViT) on I.zh: @@T0@@ImageNet 上的计算机视觉（ResNet、ViT）。@@T1@@ 在 100 个轮次内做余弦衰减；ResNet 无需预热，ViT 约需 5 个轮次的预热。峰值学习率约 0.1（SGD）或 1e-3（AdamW）。
@@T0@@Computer vision (ResNet, ViT) on I.src: Computer vision (ResNet, ViT) on ImageNet. Cosine decay over 100 epochs, no warmup needed for ResNet, ~5 epochs warmup for ViT. Peak LR ≈ 0.1 (SGD) or 1e-3 (AdamW).

@@T0@@LLM pretraining.@@T1@@ Linear warm.zh: @@T0@@LLM 预训练。@@T1@@ 线性预热约占总词元数的 1%，随后余弦衰减至峰值的 10%。峰值学习率从约 3e-4（小模型）到约 1e-4（70B 以上）。
@@T0@@LLM pretraining.@@T1@@ Linear warm.src: LLM pretraining. Linear warmup ~1% of total tokens, then cosine decay to 10% of peak. Peak LR ~3e-4 (small) down to ~1e-4 (70B+).

@@T0@@LLM SFT / instruction tuning.@@T1@.zh: @@T0@@LLM 的 SFT / 指令微调。@@T1@@ 短线性预热（约 50 步），余弦衰减至零。峰值学习率约为 2e-5 至 5e-5。相比预训练@@T2@@低得多@@T3@@，以避免灾难性遗忘。
@@T0@@LLM SFT / instruction tuning.@@T1@.src: LLM SFT / instruction tuning. Short linear warmup (~50 steps), cosine to zero. Peak LR ~2e-5 to ~5e-5. Much lower than pretraining to avoid catastrophic forgetting.

@@T0@@LoRA fine-tuning.@@T1@@ Constant o.zh: @@T0@@LoRA 微调。@@T1@@ 恒定或单次余弦周期。峰值学习率约 1e-4。适配器参数能比基础参数承受更高的学习率。
@@T0@@LoRA fine-tuning.@@T1@@ Constant o.src: LoRA fine-tuning. Constant or single cosine cycle. Peak LR ~1e-4. Adapter parameters tolerate higher rates than the base.

@@T0@@Object detection / segmentation.@@.zh: @@T0@@目标检测 / 分割。@@T1@@ 阶梯调度（在训练进度 60%、80% 处乘以 0.1）。这是经典的 DETR / Mask R-CNN 方案。
@@T0@@Object detection / segmentation.@@.src: Object detection / segmentation. Step schedule (multiply by 0.1 at 60%, 80% of training). The classical DETR / Mask R-CNN recipe.

@@T0@@Diffusion training.@@T1@@ Constant.zh: @@T0@@扩散模型训练。@@T1@@ 恒定学习率 + 权重 EMA。隐式的「衰减」主要由 EMA 承担。
@@T0@@Diffusion training.@@T1@@ Constant.src: Diffusion training. Constant LR + EMA on weights. The EMA does most of the implicit "decay".

One-cycle vs cosine vs constant.zh: 单周期、余弦与恒定三者对比

Three regimes you'll see in production:.zh: 你在生产实践中会遇到的三种范式：
Three regimes you'll see in production:.src: Three regimes you'll see in production:

@@T0@@Constant LR + decay-at-the-end.@@T.zh: @@T0@@恒定学习率 + 结尾衰减。@@T1@@ 为 Chinchilla 及近期的 Llama 训练所采用。在训练时长经过良好调校时，其经验表现与余弦相当；对于超长训练，其行为更易于分析。
@@T0@@Constant LR + decay-at-the-end.@@T.src: Constant LR + decay-at-the-end. Used by Chinchilla, recent Llama runs. Empirically as good as cosine when training duration is well-tuned; simpler to reason about for very long runs.

@@T0@@Cosine annealing@@T1@@ (Loshchilov.zh: @@T0@@余弦退火@@T1@@（Loshchilov & Hutter，2017）。平滑衰减；是 HuggingFace Trainer 与 PyTorch Lightning 中的默认选项。带重启的余弦（“SGDR”）会周期性地回到峰值 — 在 2022 年之前流行于视觉领域，如今在 LLM 中基本已被弃用。
@@T0@@Cosine annealing@@T1@@ (Loshchilov.src: Cosine annealing (Loshchilov & Hutter, 2017). Smooth decay; the default in HuggingFace Trainer, PyTorch Lightning. Cosine with restarts ("SGDR") periodically resets to peak — was popular pre-2022 for vision, mostly abandoned for LLMs.

@@T0@@1-cycle (Leslie Smith, 2018).@@T1@.zh: @@T0@@单周期（Leslie Smith，2018）。@@T1@@ 学习率与动量的联合扫掠 — 短预热、长余弦衰减、极低的尾部。对于短训练过程（少于 1000 个轮次）效果强劲。对 LLM 而言多已成为历史，但对小规模 CNN 训练仍有价值。
@@T0@@1-cycle (Leslie Smith, 2018).@@T1@.src: 1-cycle (Leslie Smith, 2018). LR + momentum sweep — short warmup, long cosine decay, very low tail. Strong for short training runs (fewer than 1000 epochs). Mostly historical for LLMs but still useful for small-scale CNN training.

@@T0@@Loshchilov &amp; Hutter (2017)@@T1.zh: @@T0@@Loshchilov & Hutter (2017)@@T1@@ — @@T2@@SGDR: Stochastic Gradient Descent with Warm Restarts。@@T3@@
@@T0@@Loshchilov &amp; Hutter (2017)@@T1.src: Loshchilov & Hutter (2017) — SGDR: Stochastic Gradient Descent with Warm Restarts.

@@T0@@Smith (2018)@@T1@@ — @@T2@@A Disci.zh: @@T0@@Smith (2018)@@T1@@ — @@T2@@A Disciplined Approach to Neural Network Hyper-Parameters。@@T3@@ 单周期方法的论文。
@@T0@@Smith (2018)@@T1@@ — @@T2@@A Disci.src: Smith (2018) — A Disciplined Approach to Neural Network Hyper-Parameters. The 1-cycle paper.

@@T0@@Liu et&nbsp;al. (2020)@@T1@@ — @@T.zh: @@T0@@Liu 等 (2020)@@T1@@ — @@T2@@On the Variance of the Adaptive Learning Rate and Beyond (RAdam)。@@T3@@ 解释预热为何对 Adam 有帮助。
@@T0@@Liu et&nbsp;al. (2020)@@T1@@ — @@T.src: Liu et al. (2020) — On the Variance of the Adaptive Learning Rate and Beyond (RAdam). Why warmup helps Adam.

@@T0@@Hoffmann et&nbsp;al. (2022)@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@Hoffmann 等 (2022)@@T1@@ — @@T2@@Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models (Chinchilla)。@@T3@@ 恒定学习率配结尾衰减的方案。
@@T0@@Hoffmann et&nbsp;al. (2022)@@T1@@.src: Hoffmann et al. (2022) — Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models (Chinchilla). The constant-LR-with-decay recipe.

meta.summary: 四种调度，同一画布。在阶梯衰减、指数衰减、余弦退火与预热+余弦之间切换。拖动峰值学习率、预热比例与周期长度。观察训练过程中的学习率曲线以及各调度叠加的损失曲线 — 并弄清为何以峰值学习率冷启动会使现代架构发散。
